H01-05: Inspection of navigation elements for a current page indicator.
Pass: Primary navigation has an active indicator (aria-current, active class) or class divergence.
Fail: No active indicator or class divergence exists across multiple links.
1. Select <nav> or [role="navigation"]. Flag if none exist.
2. Skip footers or secondary navs (social, pagination).
3. Collect valid <a> links inside the nav.
4. Check for explicit active indicators (.active, aria-current, etc.) or class styling divergence.
If the page lacks a navigation bar entirely:
- Add a navigation element containing links and an active indicator to show the current location.
If the navigation bar lacks an active page indicator:
- Add an aria-current="page" attribute or an .active CSS class to visually highlight the current page link.
